ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High-contrast distribution with approximately 65% high-intensity white pixels and 35% low-intensity black pixels across the visible ventral surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Two dominant white contiguous zones occupy the lateral lobes. These are bisected by a dark, roughly triangular central region extending from the peduncle connection. Distinct black mottling and speckling are mapped to the distal tips of both lobes and along the lower interior margins.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Distinct V-shaped median notch with an approximate vertex angle of 100-110 degrees and a depth ratio of ~1:10 relative to fluke span.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Highly irregular topography characterized by coarse, high-amplitude serrations. A significant semi-circular indentation is visible on the trailing edge of the right lobe. The distal margins exhibit a jagged, high-frequency peak-and-valley pattern.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Lobes follow an upward-curving, broadly convex sweep from the notch to the tips, significantly modified by irregular peripheral serrations.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Spatial clusters of white circular pixel groups (5-20 pixels in diameter) are detected primarily at the distal tips and along the lower boundary of the central dark pigmentation zone.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Numerous distinct linear pixel disruptions are visible. A set of prominent parallel vertical rake marks is located in the center-left dark region. Several thin diagonal scratches are mapped across the left lateral white lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Deep, irregular jagged notches on the right lobe trailing edge indicating significant tissue loss. Multiple sets of parallel linear rake marks across the central and left fluke regions.
other_distinctive_markers: A single, isolated small circular dark-intensity void (focal point) is visible in the upper-right quadrant of the white right lobe.
